user: Will the dispute cover the full charge?
answer:
The knowledge base I can access doesn't say whether a dispute can cover part of a charge, so I can't confirm that. The dispute tool does accept an amount, which defaults to the full transaction amount, but I can't tell you from the documentation whether a partial amount is allowed.

For a duplicate charge, the full EUR 240.00 would be the amount at issue for either TechMart entry. Which transaction are you disputing, and which reason applies? Once you tell me, I'll check eligibility first and open nothing without your confirmation. If you need a ruling on partial amounts, I can escalate to a human agent.

Currency conversion guide
## Reading a quote
A complete quote lists: mid rate, spread percentage applied, allowance total
and allowance used before this conversion, gross converted amount, spread
amount, and the final credited amount. The final amount equals the gross
amount minus the spread amount.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Complaints
## Difference from a dispute
A dispute concerns a specific transaction. A complaint concerns the service
itself: a delay, an error, or the conduct of an agent. The two follow separate
processes.
